intent: enterprise Phase 4: Migration 010 SQL views + transcripts list UX polish
notes: Add Migration 010 (`enterprise/migrations/versions/010_transcript_query_views.py`) — three cross-tenant SQL views over the Phase 1 tables. `recent_transcripts` mirrors the `transcripts list` shape (metadata + `linked_commit_count` via LEFT JOIN + GROUP BY). `commits_with_transcript_coverage` returns per-commit `linked_transcript_count` + `best_linkage_rank` (numeric CASE-based) + `best_linkage_basis_ranked` (human-readable) — CASE-based rank because the string basis values don't sort alphabetically. `unlinked_recent_transcripts` is the 7-day investigation queue. All three intentionally cross-tenant; caller adds `WHERE organization_id = ...`. TRIPWIRE noted in charter: view definitions reference underlying-table columns, so any column rename requires a follow-up view migration or these break silently.

Polish `transcripts list` UX (`enterprise/enterprise-cli/gator_enterprise_cli/commands/transcripts.py::_handle_list`): add `--until` (server-side upper bound on started_at — the API param existed since Phase 2 but was unshipped in the CLI), `--offset` (paginate without spamming --limit), `--unlinked` (client-side filter matching the `unlinked_recent_transcripts` view), `--sort {ingested|started|size|links}` (client-side re-sort; ingested is a no-op since server returns that order), `--wide` (adds Machine + Started columns). Per-vendor summary line auto-appears when >= 2 vendors are visible. Non-breaking: existing invocations produce byte-identical output.

Add regression test `test_ingest_routes.py::TestListTranscripts::test_until_filters_upper_bound` covering the `until` query param — it was defined in Phase 2's read endpoint but had no test coverage. Full enterprise suite: 225 passed, 1 skipped.

Write operator guide `.gator/vault/artifacts/enterprise-transcripts-mvp-operator-guide.md` (vault artifact — not shipped in git; references in-firewall deployment shape). Nine sections: prerequisites, 5-command golden path, per-verb CLI reference, operational plumbing (uvicorn boot / migrations / BlobStore layout / machine-id), five SQL query recipes (recent + coverage + audit gap + investigation queue + storage stats), post-hoc linkage recovery workflow, seven troubleshooting entries covering the failure modes surfaced during Phase 2/3 dogfooding, explicit "NOT in MVP" list, cross-references to plan/ADR/charter.

Charter update (`.gator/charters/scripts-enterprise.md`): new Phase 4 invariant block naming Migration 010 + view definitions + column-rename TRIPWIRE, list UX polish flags, operator guide artifact, live-verification stanza. Ends "MVP query surface complete" — Phases 5-6 don't touch this surface.
